methodology.source: GitHub REST workflow run/job timestamps and decoded job logs
notes: Historical observational data, not a controlled before/after benchmark.
Job duration excludes runner queue wait; run duration can include queues and downstream jobs.
Cargo Finished durations measure each Cargo command, including its build scripts and linker, not rustc-exclusive time.
Compile durations are rounded by Cargo's human-readable logger.
Only selected nightly logs were parsed; repeated Compiling lines establish repeated crate compilation, not its cause.
No test, target, feature, check or correctness gate is proposed for removal.
Only steps longer than 60 seconds are retained; complete step lists remain available from linked job pages.
